description: Join a dynamic team providing essential home health services in Billings, MT. We are seeking a dedicated Physical Therapist to deliver high-quality, patient-centered care within a home setting. This role offers the flexibility of both full-time and part-time schedules, allowing you to balance your professional and personal life while making a significant impact on patient recovery and well-being.This is an excellent opportunity for a skilled Physical Therapist looking for a rewarding travel role with competitive compensation. You will work autonomously, managing your caseload and providing personalized therapy plans to help patients regain independence and improve their quality of life. We value our clinicians and support their professional growth in a collaborative environment.Enjoy a competitive annual salary ranging from $115,000 to $125,000, reflecting your expertise and commitment. This position offers the chance to work with diverse patient populations and contribute to a leading home health program.
requirements: Doctor of Physical Therapy (DPT) degree from an accredited program
Current and unrestricted Physical Therapist license in Montana
Minimum of 1-2 years of clinical experience as a Physical Therapist, preferably in a home health setting
Valid driver's license and reliable transportation for travel to patient homes
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $115,000 - $125,000, based on experience and contract type (full-time or part-time).
